title: perilla frutescens f. rosea
intro: Perilla frutescens f. rosea, commonly known as Shiso or Beefsteak Plant, is a variety of the perilla plant, which is a member of the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is rich in health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant to protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of perilla frutescens f. rosea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, luteolin, and perillaldehyde, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
